item.title: Strategy for Building a Corporate Domain Portfolio
item.description: Today’s enterprises run many lines of business and often need a large number of domains to support their growth. This article looks at four aspects — choosing enterprise domains, domains and brand building, site SEO, and site security — and asks how an enterprise should plan and build its own domain system.
